description: This file contains the default engine configuration for a 1996 Ford Aspire, including fuel and ignition maps, engine parameters, setup functions, and configuration of sensors and hardware channels.

methods.name: setDefaultAspireMaps
methods.description: Initializes the fuel and ignition maps to default values for the Ford Aspire.

methods.name: setFordAspireEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures various engine parameters specific to the Ford Aspire, including sensor channels, ignition mode, engine specs, and loads default maps.
